parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an HTTP adapter, and everything in it is transport work that belongs in infrastructure. It sets up Express, defines routes and parses the JSON body, but it only checks the request's shape: is there an items array, is productId a string, is quantity a number. It applies no business rules (no checks on quantity ranges, stock or state transitions) and passes every use case to OrderService. It turns domain error codes into HTTP status codes, which is a transport job. It contains no persistence code. Its responsibilities fit its declared layer.
